title: Sleeps 24 | Rooftop Decks Downtown Views
description:
Two stunning adjacent luxury homes with breathtaking Nashville skyline views. 8 bedrooms, 10 bathrooms, sleeps 24. Features glamorous entertainment rooms with makeup stations & wet bars, rooftop decks with fire tables, 2 gourmet kitchens, and premium security. Just 1.5 miles to Broadway! Perfect for celebrations, reunions, or corporate retreats!

The space
Please note that there is a Gate around the entire complex (code will be given with checkin instructions).
Designated parking in each car port for 2 compact cars total (9 ft. clearance). There is available street parking for any additional cars (please be sure to check street signs to avoid towing)!
